CheckTitle: Ensure Access to Fusion is restricted via Access Control List (ACL)
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: OCI tenancy access (IAM policies, Fusion environment settings, Logging, Monitoring)
Description: The Fusion environment's ACL should allow only trusted public IPs, CIDR ranges or OCI VCNs, with no overly broad entries such as 0.0.0.0/0.
Risk: Without an ACL the application is reachable from the whole internet, enabling brute force and credential stuffing.
AuditProcedure: OCI Console > Fusion environment > network settings: ACL enabled with only trusted entries and documented exceptions.
Test from an unlisted IP to confirm it is blocked.

Steps: Enable the ACL, add trusted ranges/VCNs, remove broad entries and document exceptions.
